environment: Apple M4, Darwin arm64, Go 1.27.3, four Go threads. Load average at start 2.52 / 1.61 / 1.43. Other workloads were not stopped. Local receipt date 20261107; stage files also contain UTC timestamps.
scope: Synthetic FP32 model: vocab258, dim256, hidden704, one layer, heads4, KVheads2, context512. Model initialization is outside timing; generateInput, prompt preparation, model work, KV/workspace allocation, sampling and final Decode are inside. Fixed no-EOS tokenizer, greedy seed19. Not serving/network/disk/model-loading or real-weight throughput.
protocol: Full runtime and self/self comparisons: same executable with two package-renamed runtimes, alternating AB/BA order, three warmup pairs, explicit GC before each condition, 64 timed pairs per condition, three independent processes. Complete JSON equality checked outside timing. Self/self runs use identical production source, still in separate package namespaces; they estimate variability rather than serving as an exact causal noise correction. Build receipts pin sources, driver and executable hashes. Stage comparisons share one runtime and swap only Decode: 24 alternating pairs per condition in three processes, byte and merged controls.
ratio_definition: Candidate elapsed / baseline elapsed; below one is faster. Report each process's median of paired ratios, then the median of those three process medians. This is not a ratio of independently pooled elapsed medians and is not a confidence interval.
completion_checks: All timed and warmup completion comparisons passed; shell pipeline completed successfully. No mismatching or failed runs were discarded.
observations: Full 128-token process medians vary from +0.096% to -0.332%, with aggregate -0.023%. The byte-only Decode stage itself has aggregate +0.073%, not a demonstrated whole-generation win. Unchanged merged controls have aggregate +0.162%. Identical-runtime controls also show nonzero differences. Absolute latencies rose together during process2, e.g. roughly 43ms to 50ms for full128; do not attribute this to the code change or claim a specific external cause.
decision: No defensible end-to-end speedup established. Keep the allocation reduction and scoped Decode microbenchmark gains separate from whole-model latency. Neither a uniform no-regression guarantee nor GC-frequency/RSS/real-model throughput benefit follows. Production code, thresholds and worker counts were not changed to chase these observations.
analysis: python3 -S -m unittest discover -s scripts -p tokenizer_pieces_receipts_test.py validates finite durations, trial counts, paired ratios, reported and aggregated medians, elapsed process medians, stage source hashes and full/self build bindings. The initial local analysis was promoted into these tracked receipt tests before PR integration. All comparisons completed before analysis.
